title: Coastal Jet CJ-570 cancelled - booking record absent from airline systems

dispute.narrative: My Coastal Jet flight CJ-570 BLR-MAA was cancelled. I have not received what I am owed.

documents.title: E-ticket / itinerary receipt
documents.text:
E-TICKET / ITINERARY RECEIPT
Passenger: Sanjay Rao
Booking reference (PNR): 7LKP5X
Flight: CJ-570 BLR-MAA departing 13-Sep-2026 06:10 IST
Base fare INR 6,150.00 | Fuel charge INR 700.00 | Taxes and fees INR 1,150.00
Total paid INR 8,000.00 by credit card

documents.title: Cancellation SMS
documents.text: Dear Sanjay, Coastal Jet regrets that flight CJ-570 BLR-MAA scheduled 13-Sep-2026 06:10 IST is cancelled. Sent 12-Sep-2026 10:10 IST.

agent_run.evidence_summary: Booking 7LKP5X on CJ-570; cancellation communicated by the carrier.
agent_run.research_summary: Cancellation by the carrier triggers refund and, depending on notice, compensation.
agent_run.strategy: File a grievance with the carrier's nodal officer; escalate to the regulator if unresolved.
agent_run.appeal_draft: To the Grievance Officer, Coastal Jet: I request INR 13,000.00 for the cancellation of CJ-570 (PNR 7LKP5X) on 13 Sep 2026.
review_notes: Citations to be checked against regulation text.
citations: DGCA CAR Section 3, Series M, Part IV - compensation in addition to refund when a cancellation is notified less than 24 hours before departure
CAR Section 3 Series M Part II - refunds within 7 days for credit card purchases
